'''House Girard''' was a relatively minor [[Alderaanian/Legends|Alderaanian]] noble house that existed by the time of the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]]. They remained largely independent in the grand scheme of politics that was common place on [[Alderaan/Legends|Alderaan]] though this changed when the [[Alderaan Civil War]] broke out. This left the Girards in a dangerously exposed position and thus they decided to pledge their influence and resources to the recently returned [[House of Thul|House Thul]] who were backed by the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Sith Empire]] in exchange for their protection.<ref name="TORC">{{TORcite|type=codex|House Girard}}</ref>

The entirety of the house nobility resided in the wings of the Thul estate and the various Girard nobles awaited their inevitable victory in order to reclaim their imperiled lands along with the promise of new territories as a reward for their loyal support.<ref name="TORC" /> The house was led by [[Zacar Girard]], with [[Heitor Girard|Vice-Baron Heitor Girard]], [[Raffid Girard]] and [[Aitalla Girard]] being the closest in line to inherit the position as head of the house. Lord [[Norn Girard]] was also a prominent family member who mostly occupied his time by assisting House [[House of Thul|Thul]] with their military efforts. Zacar enlisted the future  [[Hunter (individual)|Grand Champion of the Great Hunt]] to assist with the House's ambitions on the planet by hunting down the [[Corwin|Durasteel Duke]]. The Baron unexpectedly dies, forcing the hunter to help decide which of the other leaders of the house gets to rule in the baron's place. 

==Behind the scenes==
After the completion of the Alderaan storyline, Zacar is found murdered by unknown means. This leaves their [[Hunter (individual)|advocate]] to decide the next leader of House Girard. Supporting Aitalla gives [[Light side of the Force/Legends|Light side points]], Raffid is neutral, and Heitor is [[Dark side of the Force/Legends|Dark side]]. On the other hand, if the advocate took the [[House Rist|Rist's]] offer, they have the option of wiping out the entire current family leadership, consisting of Heitor, Raffid and Aitalla. Lord [[Norn Girard]] is unaccounted for during that circumstance.
